name: tcs-traffic-congestion-system
description: Real-time Traffic Congestion System using YOLOv8 and ByteTrack

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,cyan" "python backend/server.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install
